title: A web-based cancer prevention intervention for rural emerging adults: mixed methods development and pilot-testing study
core_idea: Develop and pilot test a theory-based, community-engaged web intervention—delivered via Facebook private groups and co-created with emerging adults and stakeholder advisory boards—to reduce six cancer risk factors among rural emerging adults through targeted behavior-change messaging.
tldr: Mixed-methods development and pilot-testing of a theory-driven, co-created Facebook-delivered cancer prevention intervention aimed at reducing multiple risk behaviors among rural emerging adults.
